shortcut: SSR hydration mismatch from client-only code
detail: Rendering browser-only APIs (window, document, Date.now(), Math.random()) during server-side rendering causes hydration mismatches. The server HTML differs from the client's initial render, causing React to discard the server content and re-render from scratch, losing SSR benefits and causing a visible flash. This error is logged as 'Text content did not match' in development but can be silent in production. Prerequisite: understanding SSR lifecycle in Next.js or similar frameworks. Requires isomorphic code that works in both node and browser environments. To mitigate: use useEffect for client-only side effects, and typeof window checks. Fix: move dynamic content generation to useEffect or use suppressHydrationWarning for intentional mismatches. Test with vitest in both node and jsdom environments.
